title: A Stateful Fibonacci Generator
prompt: With your `Generator<T>` from the previous exercise, implement `fibonacci(n)` yielding the first n Fibonacci numbers (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, ...).

tests.name: first values are exact
tests.hint: long long a = 1, b = 1; for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) { co_yield a; auto t = a + b; a = b; b = t; }

tests.name: n = 0 and n = 1
tests.hint: The loop bounds handle the degenerate cases naturally.
